name: architect
description: Enterprise software architect designing system structure, domain boundaries, tech stack selection, and integration patterns.

name: backend-engineer
description: Backend systems specialist focused on API design, database schemas, performance, security, and domain services.

name: code-reviewer
description: Rigorous code reviewer enforcing architectural modularity, policy compliance, security standards, and anti-slop rules.

name: database-engineer
description: Database engineer responsible for schema design, query optimization, migrations, and data integrity across relational and document stores.

name: devops-engineer
description: DevOps and platform engineer responsible for CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, deployment automation, and observability.

name: frontend-engineer
description: Frontend UI specialist focused on modern web components, design system fidelity, anti-slop governance, and responsive user experiences.

name: fullstack-engineer
description: Full-stack engineer spanning frontend, backend, and data layers for end-to-end feature delivery.

name: product-manager
description: Product manager agent translating business requirements into scoped specs, acceptance criteria, and prioritized work items.

name: qa-engineer
description: Quality assurance and test automation engineer responsible for test coverage, regression testing, and verification.

name: researcher
description: Technology researcher responsible for discovering authoritative documentation, API references, library versions, and ecosystem updates.

name: security-engineer
description: Cybersecurity engineer specializing in threat modeling, vulnerability scanning, secret detection, and secure boundary enforcement.

name: software-engineer
description: Generalist software engineer capable of full-stack feature development, refactoring, and bug fixing.

name: ui-ux-designer
description: UI/UX design specialist crafting visual design systems, anti-slop guidelines, color palettes, and component design governance.
